title: Initial coordinate in a depth-two block
statement: For a block index $b\in\{0,1,2\}$ and a seed index $s\in\{0,1,2\}$, define the initial coordinate to be the coordinate assigned to block $b$ and the first cyclic index of $s$ by the depth-one recursive three-block embedding.
caveat: The referenced recursive block embedding is not defined in the supplied snippet, so its coordinate convention cannot be stated more explicitly.
